{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm 'completed' means not refunded
assert (data['status'] == 'completed').sum() == 815, "Expected 815 completed orders"

# Check revenue format: contains commas
print("Sample of revenue values:")
print(data['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for QA orders
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}")

# Confirm QA orders are not completed
qa_completed = data[qa_mask]['status'].value_counts()
print(f"QA orders status distribution: {qa_completed.to_dict()}")"}
